messages:
Alex: PR 23144 ready to land after minor rebase. Seeing intermittent embed-service e2e flake on GPU job. Planning to land later today but there's a deploy-freeze 22:00-02:00 UTC. Can someone eyeball CI and say if it's safe to queue? cc @Maria @Ravi
Maria: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/23144 — quick summary: cache key fix + tiny perf tweak
Ravi: I saw the flake earlier, it's `embed-service-start` timing out on GPU nodes. Seems like startup jitter, not correctness. I've reproduced locally once with `docker-compose` but hard to nail.
Alex: Thanks. CI logs show `TimeoutError: 30s waiting for grpc connect`. snippet: ```grpc_connection: failed after 30s```
CI-Bot: Build 342 - embed-e2e (gpu) failed: flake: grpc connect timeout. /rerun to retry
Jen: Heads up — ops scheduled a deploy-freeze 22:00-02:00 UTC for DB migration. If landing pushes into freeze we should hold. Can we aim for <21:30 UTC?
Maria: If Ravi can rebase + rerun, we can try for 21:00 UTC slot. @Ravi can you take?
Ravi: On it. I'll rebase, run `./scripts/ci rerun --job=embed-e2e --label=gpu` and report back. If it flakes twice, let's gate behind canary.
Alex: If it flakes twice, fallback plan: promote PR to canary only and keep stable on previous. Also, toggle feature flag `embed_new_cache` off if necessary.
Ravi: Rebase done, kicked a rerun. Local smoke passed. If CI passes, please add `merge` label, otherwise ping me and I can split the cache change into separate PR.
CI-Bot: Build 343 - embed-e2e (gpu) passed ✅
Maria: :thumbsup: Good. Alex, can you queue? I'll watch and merge if no regressions.
Alex: Queued at 20:45 UTC. Merging now. Thanks all — will monitor telemetry in console; if errors spike I'll rollback.
Ops-Bot: Deploy freeze starts at 22:00 UTC. Note: will block merges without exemption.
Maria: Merge landed. No immediate errors. 🎉
